ev.q: During 2005–2014, a total of 28 traumatic brain and spinal cord injury deaths in high school and college football were identified
Fatality rates over the study period were 5.96 fatalities per 1 million college football players
Approximately 18% of identified high school brain injury deaths were preceded by an earlier concussion
Fatality rates over the study period were 5.96 fatalities per 1 million college football players
All four of the college deaths and 14 (58%) of the 24 high school deaths occurred during the last 5 years (2010–2014)
NCCSIR has been conducting catastrophic injury surveillance at the national level
Six illustrative cases provide associations with the Haddon energy damage countermeasures

methods_quotes.q: Fatality rates per 1 million players were calculated using National Federation of State High School Associations and National Collegiate Athletic Association participation statistics
Deaths were identified through ongoing and systematic monitoring of public media sources
Each fatality report was manually reviewed for inclusion and classification.
